scope: The complete Unicode-wide prehod-/prěhod- family census in the four Latin sources after EDIT-0117: 286 sites in 27 surface forms on 244 file-lines, comprising 46 selected sites on 42 lines and 240 protected grammatical or canonical controls.
choice: Normalize 31 plain-root prehod- forms to the exact official and established prěhod- house surface while preserving inflection; repair 15 finite third-person-singular prěhodit forms to prěhodi; preserve all 240 remaining family controls.
motivation: The official type-1 lemma is prěhoditi and the edition already contains 255 prěhod- controls. Official orthography permits plain e as a simplified fallback, so the 31 prehod- changes are explicitly an editorial house-surface normalization rather than a claim of intrinsic ungrammaticality. Each of the 16 selected -it tokens was independently verified as finite third-person singular, never an infinitive, and therefore requires prěhodi under the official second-conjugation paradigm.
alternatives_rejected: Retaining the mixed prehod-/prěhod- surface was rejected because this bounded family already overwhelmingly uses the exact official prěhod- house form.
Treating every prěhodit token as an infinitive was rejected after sentence-level inspection showed that all 15 selected occurrences are finite third-person-singular predicates.
A blanket replacement of all 286 family tokens was rejected because 240 noun, adjective, infinitive and finite controls are already grammatical and canonical.
Changing valid prěhodim was rejected because official verbs.md line 87 explicitly licenses the alternative first-person-singular -im ending.
Changing prěhodžu, prěhodęt or the three true prěhoditi infinitives was rejected because their morphology and syntax are correct.
Calling plain e intrinsically invalid was rejected because official orthography permits omission of the etymological diacritic; the stated rationale is edition-level surface consistency.

evidence.official_dictionary: Official isv_words_list.csv, 7993414 bytes, SHA-256 072DE8E512EB386780D199FBD6F0ACF2639D3096EA920F1AF2D0AFCC5535E842: physical row 12293 / ID 19506 gives prěhod, type-1 transition; row 12295 / ID 2425 gives prěhoditi, intransitive imperfective type 1, cross or pass over.
evidence.official_grammar: Official verbs.md, 21426 bytes, SHA-256 3684BE0634F0163DDD4BEC09719280C3C0E1E2367009AA3DAE584C50DD6249AD: lines 75-76 place -iti verbs in the second conjugation; lines 82-85 give -ju/-iš/-i/-imo/-ite/-et; line 87 licenses alternative 1sg -im; line 97 gives d+j to dž; lines 168-174 govern the -eči present participle.
evidence.orthography_scope: Official orthography.md permits simplified plain e for ě. Accordingly, 31 sites are classified as mixed-surface normalization to the edition's exact dictionary/control spelling, not as intrinsically ungrammatical plain-e spellings.
evidence.semantic_and_morphological_audit: All 46 selected sites were inspected in sentence context. Partition: 32 third-person singular, eight third-person plural, two first-person plural, one licensed alternative first-person singular, two noun obliques and one adverbial present participle. All 16 -it sites are finite 3sg. Base line 6167 resumes the singular identičnost across displayed mathematics and aligns to German ED0014 lines 5491-5499, Die Identität ... geht ... über in.

context_receipt.algorithm: For each file in order 44-book, 45, base, bib, serialize every selected token as filename<TAB>line<TAB>column<TAB>token<TAB>full-line<LF>.

evidence.protected_domains: The 46 targets comprise 42 ordinary body-prose sites, including three translated footnotes and one emphasized theorem. None lies in comments, raw mathematics, control names, foreign/foreignlanguage, URL/href, label/ref/pageref/eqref/cite or bibliography-identity payloads.
evidence.independent_qa: Two independent read-only audits reproduced the 286/46/240 census, all 16 finite -it classifications, receipts, official evidence, protected controls, output hashes, zero selected residue and structural invariants and returned ACCEPT with no defect.

validation.coverage: The exact 286-site broad census, 46-site selected census, nine-form source histogram, file partition and all four receipts match the hash-gated input.
validation.postcondition: All nine selected source forms are zero while the broad family remains exactly 286 and the exact 240-control post histogram matches.
validation.structure: UTF-8 NFC/no-BOM/LF transport, terminal LF, line count, raw braces, ordered TeX controls, environments, label/ref/cite sequence, math delimiters, comments and protected payloads are invariant; only base changes.
validation.reproducibility: Independent replay reproduces base 1898424 bytes / 1AE144963D3D06B2B6315E06BF62A0C9274CBBBB5779C00BFA26CC27C93AC59E and proves the other three sources byte-identical.
